full_judgment:
Md Mozibur Rahman Miah, J: This appeal is directed at the instance of the plaintiff-appellant against the judgment and decree dated 24-10-2018 passed by the learned Joint District Judge, 2nd Court, Dhaka allowing an application so field by the present respondent Nos. 1-7 as defendants under Order VII, rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure through which the learned judge rejected the plaint. 

 10. On the contrary, Mr AKM Zakir Uzzaman Khan, the learned counsel appearing for the defendant-respondent Nos. 2-7 by taking us to the application for rejection of plaint at the very outset submits that, since the suit land as well as averment made in the plaint over the claim is totally different so the plaintiff is not entitled to any decree in the form of declaration of title.
